sections.name: mission
sections.value: Cross-model review of s122 at pinned commit c5c7fd2c: tmux types the FULL framed body into pane seats; the pointer rung is retired. READ-ONLY. Your question is the MECHANISM. Context you must weigh: this unit's own live witness already caught a real defect the tests missed — a parked human draft was clobbered because gate inputs were hardcoded. Assume more of that class remains.

sections.name: instructions
value: Read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md, assets/live-pane-witnesses-2026-09-01.md, assets/pointer-witness-disposition-2026-09-01.json, then the diff at c5c7fd2c

PRIORITY 1 — the paste/typing boundary: a body that is chunked or pasted must arrive INTACT and as ONE submission. Hunt for the partial-submit and interleaving cases: what happens if the pane is written to mid-paste, or the body contains newlines, a leading slash, or bracket sequences the terminal interprets

PRIORITY 2 — one-capture gate semantics: verify the single fresh_injection_verdict genuinely feeds BOTH facts to the real call sites, and that no hardcoded gate input survives anywhere. That exact shape caused the clobber. Also confirm SOCKET behaviour is unchanged, including the 60s parked-draft expiry

PRIORITY 3 — the retired pointer witnesses: the PM was required to label each removed test RETARGETED or RETIRED. Audit that disposition file against the diff — a test labelled retargeted must actually exist in its new form; a retirement must name what replaced it. This is where a guard silently disappears

PRIORITY 4 — TypedToPane receipt + migration 0011: the receipt must be honest (a typed pane is NOT an observed delivery — check nothing upgrades it to a stronger claim), and the CHECK-constraint widening must converge with s121's 0010/SCHEMA_VERSION without either stream renumbering
The live transcripts are evidence: verify they show what they claim, including the negative case (a draft that was NOT clobbered)
Report findings to the PRIME (pij-still-weasel), never sideways to the coder. Verdict: APPROVE or findings with severity.
